question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses, considering only degree-granting courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.

WHERE c.DEPARTMENT = '18'

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, NULL AS student_full_name, NULL AS student_email_address, NULL AS school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs WHERE NOT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM StudentInfo)) SELECT department_name, department_full_name, student_full_name, student_email_address, school_code_dense_rank, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY department_full_name, student_full_name

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), CIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, cs.cip_code_range, cs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN CIPStats AS cs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY si.school_code_dense_rank, si.student_full_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dcs JOIN (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2) AS ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, inner_cte.range_cip_program_code, inner_cte.var_cip_program_code, inner_cte.HGN_CODE, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HGN_CODE
